Save Project Context

Store project information so your AI remembers it across sessions.

Why Save Context?​

Without memory, you re-explain your project every session:

"This is a monorepo using Turborepo. We use TypeScript, Hono for the API, React for frontend. We deploy to Cloudflare. Our auth uses JWT..."

With Nexus memory, you say this once and recall it forever.

Quick Start​

Ask your AI to save context:

"Remember that this project uses TypeScript, Hono for the API, React for frontend, and deploys to Cloudflare Workers"

Memory saved
→ AI calls save-memory
   title: "Project Tech Stack"
   type: project_context
   content: "TypeScript, Hono API, React frontend, Cloudflare Workers"

✓ Memory saved!

Memory Types​

TypeUse ForExample
project_contextTech stack, architecture, conventions"Monorepo with Turborepo"
decisionArchitectural decisions with rationale"Using JWT because..."
session_summaryWhat was accomplished"Implemented user auth"
correctionLessons learned, things to avoid"Don't use library X because..."

Project Context​

"Remember our project architecture: Monorepo with apps/web (Next.js), apps/api (Hono), and packages/shared"

Decisions​

"Remember that we decided to use Drizzle instead of Prisma because of edge runtime support"

Corrections​

"Remember: don't suggest using moment.js - we use date-fns instead"

Recalling Context​

At the start of a new session:

"What do you remember about this project?"

Context recalled
→ AI calls get-project-context
   project: "my-project"

Found 3 memories:

1. Project Architecture (project_context)
   Monorepo with Turborepo. apps/web (Next.js)...

2. Auth Decision (decision)
   Using JWT with httpOnly cookies...

3. Avoid moment.js (correction)
   Use date-fns instead of moment.js...

Best Practices​

Name Your Project​

Always specify a project name for organization:

"Save this to project 'my-app': We use Tailwind CSS with the default config"

Use Tags​

Tags help with semantic search:

"Remember (tags: auth, security): We use httpOnly cookies for JWT storage"

Be Specific​

❌ "We use React"
   → Too vague

✓ "We use React 18 with Server Components in Next.js App Router"
   → Specific and searchable

Include Rationale​

For decisions, include the why:

❌ "We use Drizzle"

✓ "We use Drizzle instead of Prisma because:
   1. Edge runtime support
   2. SQL-like syntax we prefer
   3. Smaller bundle size"

CLI Commands​

Memory management via CLI
nexus memory save --title "Project Architecture" --type project_context --project my-app --content "Monorepo..."

✓ Memory saved: mem_abc123

nexus memory search "authentication"

Found 2 memories:
  1. Auth Pattern (decision)
  2. Login Flow (session_summary)

nexus memory context --project my-app

Project context for my-app:
  3 project_context memories
  2 decision memories
  1 correction memory

Authentication Required​

Memory write operations require authentication:

Login to save memories
npx @nexus/cli auth login

Opening browser...

✓ Authenticated as user@example.com

Once authenticated, your AI can save and recall memories automatically.
